newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia CPI up 3.7 pct in June from May.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia CPI up 3.7 pct in June from May.

text.p: Mongolia's consumer price index increased by 3.7 percent in June compared with May, figures from the Bank of Mongolia, the central bank, showed on Tuesday.
The figure compared with a rise of 4.2 percent in May against April, the Bank of Mongolia said in its Monthly Statistical Bulletin.
The consumer price index rose 23.5 percent in the first six months of the year, the bulletin said.
The bulletin gave no year-on-year figure because the basket of goods used by the State Statistical Office to calculate consumer price inflation was changed in January, it said.
